decisions.text: a narrow-range inset: the values lie in a narrow range far from zero (232 to 274: the gap from zero is at least their spread) and the small differences among them matter (facts.small_differences_matter); the main scale keeps zero, and the inset shows every mark on a truncated scale, 230–280 by 10 (the largest step below the lowest value, so the lowest bar keeps a stub above the lowest gridline) (G2.7)
nominal categories sorted by value, descending
“Far West” and “Rockies” come within 10 pt of each other under vertical bars, with every multi-word name wrapped: horizontal bars, names right-aligned at the left
labels as a set, 0 decimals, bare numbers: 0, 50, 100, 150, 200, 250, 300
digits hidden: thousands, stated in the scale's title (R2-05, D-3): “Donations ($K)”
a horizontal scale: bare numbers, and its title centred below with the unit in parentheses: “Donations ($K)”
the inset beside the horizontal bars, on the same rows, the two plots sharing the width as their scale labels need it

the inset's form: a frame round the band 200–300 of the main chart, across its rows, a larger frame round a complete small chart (230–280 by 10, its unit in its title (“Donations ($K)”), the category labels repeated, no title, text at inset size), two links forming a widening cone, beneath the frames (G2.27)
the inset's bars run 9.5 pt past its lowest gridline (230) and fade to transparent there: they do not start at zero, and nothing below the gridline pretends to be a length (G2.28)

source.shows: the narrow-range inset beside horizontal bars (the chart turns at the text width, the names not fitting under columns): the main chart from zero, however narrow the range (R2-23, R9-5); the inset on the same rows, 230–280 by 10, its bars fading below the 230 gridline, the names repeated and its scale titled; a frame round the main chart’s 200–300 band across the rows, two links to the inset’s corners (G2.7, G2.27, G2.28)
